public_interpretation.actual_manifest_assessment: 1,728 exact-candidate-bound named inherited-control entries cover 864 true pairs at both lengths. Generic inline control_id strings have no literal manifest entry or group alias; no exact control_id format was prescribed, so this mismatch is recorded as a custody limitation rather than an invented independent hard failure. Public grouping reconstructs the intended evidence.
public_interpretation.ambiguity_resolution: A release cannot silently choose the broad waiver over the retained specialization. Hold these exact records and publish a prospective explicit version/encoding clarification; prefer a fresh metadata-corrected candidate retaining visible tasks/targets with exact inherited pair IDs and corresponding named length-specific evidence. Preserve old hashes/reviews/specifications.
public_interpretation.author_responsibility: This actual adjudicator authored the ambiguous V3 sentence. That ambiguity is a design defect; it explains producer/reviewer behavior and cannot be attributed solely to production. This nonblind interpretation is not an independent-model result.
public_interpretation.best_cumulative_reading: V2 specialized actual same-family pair binding remains applicable to its two named controls. The documented inline encoding is pair_sample_ids; V3 expressly preserves original/v2 fields and gives precedence for grouping only. Its new-control section does not explicitly repeal those specializations.
public_interpretation.explicit_vs_inferred: Actual pair identities and length-specific evidence are explicit V2 requirements. Requiring the inline pair_sample_ids field is a supported encoding inference from the closed field vocabulary, not a verbatim must-contain-field sentence.
public_interpretation.strongest_alternative: V3 line48 is later and says pair-specific evidence may include pair_sample_ids without an explicit identifier qualifier. Read broadly, it permits external aggregate bindings for inherited claims too. The actual manifest supplies every named length-specific pair and is independently reconstructable by public source family/variant/name/schedule/renderer grouping. Under that broad reading, semantics and aggregate evidence are sufficient; do not assert missing pairs.

recommended_unambiguous_encoding: Both inherited corpus_variant claim objects contain pair_sample_ids of two actual distinct same-family supplied IDs. Use a length-specific manifest entry whose exact control_id resolves with the same name, pair IDs and row hashes. The same pair/control ID may support both identifiers; no globally unique-ID-per-property assumption. A nonmember context row may carry a family claim referring to its matched E/G or F/H evidence; it is not a per-row truth tag.
required_fix: Publish NEW prospective clarification naming the two inherited controls and their inline/manifest encoding. Fresh metadata revision must carry exact same-family/variant/schedule/style E/G or F/H pairs with length-specific evidence, preserve visible tasks/targets if unchanged, recompute record hashes and obtain completed new expert/red/adjudication receipts. Do not edit V3 candidate/spec/first reviews or silently relax its gate.
residual_quality_limits: Four reused families, 32 contexts, 64 scalar cases and correlated 27x2 nuisance views;75% nonempty/87.5% query-usefulness-false majority; fitted finite table/frequency/length associations persist. Same-model/guided correction and design/adjudication overlap; no complete shortcut elimination or efficacy.
